2026_primary.fact: Wayback capture 20260304022512 (2026-03-03 20:25:12 CST, election night) of the county's linked results page https://www.livevoterturnout.com/ENR/williamsontxenr/11/en/Index_11.html (saved at phase1/targeted/wayback/Williamson/2026_primary_20260304022512_9b39a3cd35db.html). Page title 'Election Night Results', 'Unofficial Election Results', 'March 3, 2026 Primary Elecition', 'Website Updated: 3/3/2026 7:29:36 PM', hidden field hdnAutoRefresh value="600" with an Auto-Refresh option, hdnPrecinctLevelResults value="1". Each contest has a 'VIEW RESULTS BY PRECINCT' link (onclick="PrecinctTabClick(); SetPrecinctResults('race', '10')") and the same page carries a 'Precinct Results' view with 178 precinct blocks, each holding per-precinct candidate rows, e.g. aria-label="Precinct: 116 - Contest: REP United States Senator" with candidate 'Sara Canady' and a vote cell 0. The precinct view is generated in the same refreshing page as the county totals, so it is the live precinct view of the live precinct view rule (DECISIONS 39): LIVE from check 3, confidence capped at med. Caveat: at 7:29 PM every number is 0 ('Precincts Reported: 0 of 178', all 178 precincts 'Not Reported'), so the capture proves the view existed on election night, not how many releases carried numbers. Today's copy shows 'Website Updated: 3/12/2026 4:29:55 PM' (Last-Modified Thu, 12 Mar 2026 21:29:57 GMT), canvass state only, all 178 precincts 'Reporting'.

2026_runoff.fact: Results archive links the May 26, 2026 runoff to ENR Index_14.html plus reconciliation, hand count audit, and polling-location vote-count PDFs (no precinct candidate report). Today's Index_14.html: 'Website Updated: 6/2/2026 11:19:37 AM' (Last-Modified Tue, 02 Jun 2026 16:19:37 GMT), canvass state, with 177 precinct blocks. No election-night capture in the targeted Wayback search of the ENR host for May 26-27 2026 (zero captures); the general harvest of wilco.org was robots-blocked for this window. Sweep pending.

rationale: Only the 2026 primary is decided (LIVE, check 3 under the live precinct view rule); the other two elections have no election-night evidence. One determined election gives LIVE_PRECINCT with low confidence. Disclosure: before starting, a routine `git log --oneline` showed the latest commit subjects, which name research's pass 3 tags for Williamson, Polk, and Harrison; no evidence file, DECISIONS item 60 to 62, counties.csv, or targeted3 scratch file was opened before this file was written, and every result here rests on sources I opened myself.
